meta.bodyHeight: total capsule height incl. both hemispheres; centre = position; spine half length = height/2 - radius with integer (floor) division
meta.nearBoundary: exact margin within 2 raw units of flipping. The shipped (exact) algorithm must pass every case; a deliberately relaxed (<=1 raw) implementation may skip nearBoundary cases that are not exactTangent
meta.exactTangent: hand-built case whose exact answer is a perfect tangent or one raw unit off; always testable
